tests: Default armor is metallic steel; shield face remains white dielectric; appearance panel starts collapsed
Armor, shield face, shield stripe, spear wood and spear metal controls change only their own material slots; crest, backing, leather and body remain unchanged
Appearance and actual shader material values survive a page reload
UI JSON export/import preserves all appearance fields and materials; Reset restores the default steel/white configuration
Malformed, incompatible, invalid-enum and oversized JSON imports leave current appearance intact; invalid partial API update is atomic
Review records capture and restore appearance together with pose/time; old records without appearance restore documented defaults
Base GLB download remains byte-identical to the verified artifact after customization; the UI labels it as the base model and JSON uses a separate filename
390 px layout has no horizontal overflow; customization controls have labels and usable touch targets
Corrupt browser storage falls back to defaults with feedback; unavailable storage still allows editing and JSON export with an explicit persistence warning
scope: Appearance material isolation, persistence, profile validation, review reproducibility and mobile controls in software Chromium. No real-device performance or equipment-geometry replacement claim.
